newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Tatra Banka to launch 3-yr 1 bln crown bond.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Tatra Banka to launch 3-yr 1 bln crown bond.

text.p: Slovak commercial bank Tatra Banka a.s. on Friday said it would launch a three-year, one-billion crown, bond early next year.
The issue, approved by an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on Friday, will be made once the bank's board of directors agrees on the final details.
"The board will determine the details of the issue early in January which will correspond to the conditions on the Slovak capital market at the time," Tatra bank spokesman Ivan Bednar told Reuters.
The bank will use the funds from the issue for expansion and the gradual transformation of its liabilities into longer-term resources with fixed interest rates.
